paragraphs.text: Castle Sengir is the citadel on Ulgrotha that Baron Sengir wrested from its dwarven builders.

Castle Sengir is the capital of the Dark Barony , and the place from which the Baron and his Sengir vampires launched their attacks on Ulgrotha. Beneath the castle is the Dwarven Gate , a planar portal through which the Baron planned to move his forces once he had subjugated the world.

The Castle of Morning Light was the name the dwarves of Ulgrotha gave to the castle they built above ground over the Dwarven Gate of New Freedom on Ulgrotha . This castle later became Castle Sengir when Baron Sengir took control of it, ousting the dwarves from New Freedom and taking control of the Dwarven Gate himself.
